cost: Read O(file bytes), ordered maps O(rows log keys), set-vector membership can be quadratic; residual-key sorting O(K log K) comparisons and O(K) retained keys with variable string-copy/comparison costs; output O(rendered bytes).
description: Compare residual/normal TSV snapshots with permissive numeric parsing, before-domain sets, a full residual-key union ordered by (known-layer priority, class, layer), changed-row thresholds and known-layer totals.
forward: Read residual(a), residual(b), normal(a), normal(b) in that failure order. Numeric parse failure becomes zero while NaN parses. Residual duplicate keys are last-wins; normal first rows fix totals and later rows add class counts.

Enumerate before-domain sets; sort the full residual-key union by (known-layer priority or 9, class, layer), once per key. Unknown layers follow class then layer order. Emit abs change >= 0.05 and known-layer totals excluding meta.
inverse: Within admitted successful reads, exclude repeated residual full keys or residual changed-row order violating (priority, class, layer). After-only sets and unmatched after normal starts are omitted.
Rounded output admits many TSV antecedents; overwritten duplicate rows and ignored short rows are unrecoverable. A single emitted key does not identify the number or order of original rows.
limitations: Finite synthetic helper evidence only; live corpora, parser/model loading, full orchestration and filesystem failure races excluded.
Partial source syntax, finite tests, no semantic proof or executable percent surrogate
state: Owned temporary TSVs with admitted residual/normal rows of at least seven/eight columns; unrestricted layer strings. Meaningful ratios require finite nonnegative metrics, but parsing accepts nonfinite values.
